title: Raise
tagline: Platform that will help you to raise funds for your idea to save the world
description: This platform is a powerful tool that empowers individuals and organizations to raise funds for their innovative ideas aimed at saving the world. By connecting people with donors who share their vision, this platform can help to turn groundbreaking concepts into impactful initiatives that make a real difference for our planet and its inhabitants.
how_its_made: The platform that helps you raise funds for your idea to save the world is powered by cutting-edge technology. The use of the Scroll blockchain and the Polybase database enables the platform to operate securely and efficiently. The Scroll blockchain ensures that all transactions on the platform are transparent, tamper-proof, and decentralized. Meanwhile, Polybase provides a scalable and reliable database solution, enabling the platform to store and manage large amounts of data. Together, these technologies provide a solid foundation for the platform, allowing it to support a wide range of projects and attract donors from all around the world.
